classification: outcome-informed architecture calibration on frozen T-071A pilot seeds; design evidence only

controller.rollback_margin_rule: minus one half of the frozen gain
controller.candidate_rule: first-half empirical prediction loss plus safety-debt times squared mixing displacement
controller.verification_rule: rollback when disjoint second-half proposal excess loss exceeds the frozen margin

descriptive_criteria.C1: finite complete reuse of all 432 cells and 32 T-071A seeds
descriptive_criteria.C2: at least 5 percent geometric cumulative-risk improvement on nonstationary cells
descriptive_criteria.C3: strict improvement in at least 55 percent of nonstationary cells
descriptive_criteria.C4: at least 2 percent improvement in both nonstationary schedule families
descriptive_criteria.C5: nonnegative improvement in every delay group
descriptive_criteria.C7: exactly 240 learning transitions, zero extra probe transitions, at most 18 message units
descriptive_criteria.C8: positive accepted nonlocal action rate and finite nonnegative safety debt
